title: Return-Shipping Label Charge for Depot Repairs, Northgate Protect
content:
A return-shipping label charge is added to the authorized repair value for depot repairs under a Northgate Protect single-item plan: the computer label charge for a computer or tablet outside the tier's in-home service categories, the standard label charge for any other item outside those categories, and nothing for an item in those categories. The item is placed by the item category of the covered order line in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records.

| Item category of the covered order line | Label charge |
|---|---|
| Computers and tablets, outside the tier's in-home categories | $24.50 |
| Any other category outside the tier's in-home categories (mobile phones included) | $12.75 |
| In the tier's in-home service categories | Nothing |

The tier's in-home service categories are, on the Standard tiers, major appliances, fitness equipment, furniture and TV and home theater, and on the Accident tiers, TV and home theater.

## Cases (hypothetical items)

- A tablet: $24.50.
- A mobile phone: $12.75.
- A robot vacuum (small appliances): $12.75.
- A television on any single-item tier: nothing.
